text:
Tom (PM): morning team. need a firm call for the July milestone: do we include multi-tenant embeddings cache in MVP or defer to v1? trade: cache = better perf + customer ask (Acme/Beacon), but risky infra churn. alternative is ship embeddings without cache (higher cost, some perf loss) and keep prompt-templating. we have 48h to lock the cutlist. quick takes pls.
Jules (Eng): infra summary: cache rollout touches KV shard routing and our eviction hooks. current branch causes rare OOMs under bursty long-seq loads. full fix is ~2 weeks of dev + validation. non-cached path (stateless vector store) is ~3 dev days and straightforward.
Marta (ML): evals show cached path improves recall by ~8% and reduces P95 by ~150ms for long queries. non-cached is acceptable for onboarding customers but will show poorer tail quality. for ACME pilot, cached is strongly preferred.
Olive (Design): templating improves conversion in onboarding flows by ~12% in tests. if we cut templating and keep non-cached embeddings, onboarding might be tougher but manageable with better examples.
Carlos (CS): ACME explicitly asked for multi-tenant cache. Their legal team also wants a documented rollback SLA. They said they'd "consider" going live with a pilot lane but prefer product-level availability.
Tom (PM): framing options: 1) ship full cache (delay ship by 2 weeks) 2) ship non-cached embeddings + keep templating (stay on schedule) 3) pilot-lane cache for invited customers + keep templating (compromise). what's the risk budget?
Jules (Eng): 1 is high risk to date. 2 is lowest infra risk but increases run cost and may disappoint ACME. 3 requires dedicated pool + gating logic ~6 dev days and infra provisioning, but isolates risk.
Marta (ML): 3 is attractive: ACME gets near-cache quality on the pilot pool, we avoid multi-tenant KV changes in prod, and we can run focused evals.
Olive (Design): 3 keeps templating which helps onboarding for the pilot and general users. design work for pilot labelling + consent is small.
Carlos (CS): ACME prefers 3. they agreed to an invite-only pilot if we can provide quotas, a support path, and clear expectations. they asked for a 1-week ramp rather than immediate GA.
Tom (PM): vote: 1=full-cache+delay, 2=non-cached+templating, 3=pilot-lane cache+templating
Jules (Eng): 3
Marta (ML): 3
Olive (Design): 3
Carlos (CS): 3
Tom (PM): consensus = 3. decision notes: defer multi-tenant cache for GA; implement a pilot-lane cache on dedicated infra for invited customers; keep prompt-templating in MVP. need action items and owners.
ops-bot: created feature-flag rollout/embeds-pilot-lane (staged=false)
Jules (Eng): actions: open INFRA-3050 to provision dedicated cache pool + emergency kill-switch; implement gating + quota logic (3 dev days); add telemetry hooks for P95 and recall. PR incoming.
Marta (ML): I'll add targeted eval suites and a dashboard tile (embeds-recall-pilot) and define acceptance thresholds for pilot onboarding.
Olive (Design): I'll draft the pilot UX flows, the "invite-only" banner, and the templating quickstart. sharing in drive.
Carlos (CS): I'll prepare the pilot onboarding checklist, SLA language for invited customers, and schedule ACME's ramp call.
Tom (PM): I'll update the release tracker: "MVP cut: defer multi-tenant embeddings cache to v1; include pilot-lane cache for invited customers; retain prompt-templating in MVP. contingency: if pilot pool shows instability, kill pilot flag and revert to non-cached path." tagging @launch-team. keep status updates here. :rocket:
